selected_candidates.reason: Directly disrupts the entry point of the golden journey; pod kill causes immediate unavailability of the entire front-end, exposing lack of redundancy or failover.
Catalogue is critical for browsing; 2000ms delay on catalogue service will severely degrade page load times, impacting user experience and potentially causing timeouts.
Login depends on user service; 2000ms delay will make login sluggish or fail, directly blocking a key step in the golden journey.
Orders service is essential for order placement; 2000ms delay will cause order submission to be slow or fail, impacting the final step of the journey.
